title: VEIL: choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned Numbered Account. Keep it, take my pick or the standard look, or re-roll.

options.label: Numbered Account
options.lineage: Swiss numbered accounts and safe-deposit vaults
options.thesis: Your identity is an engraved number on a brass plate; everything else stays in the vault.
options.viewport: Green leather rail with your own brass name plate on top, conversations as plates below, the open conversation on a deep vault ground.
options.risk: Can tip into private-bank luxury if brass spreads beyond its one job.

raised.raise: Hairline-ruled lists replace padded floating cards; the screen stops looking empty.
Brass is reserved for one job: your own identity and the active selection.
All neutrals come from one strict tonal ramp of the vault green.
State colours appear only where they carry meaning: a key change, a failure, verified.

options.label: Passport
options.lineage: passport covers and guilloche security printing
options.thesis: An identity document that names no one: navy cover, gold foil, a guilloche seal per person.
options.viewport: Navy shell, each contact sealed with a fine guilloche rosette, safety numbers set like a document number.
options.risk: Guilloche can read as busy line noise again, and as government paperwork.

options.label: Character Goods Catalog
options.thesis: Contacts as a ranked cast of mascots.
options.case: Playful and colourful, which the brief rules out.
options.kept: Every contact carries the same fixed name-plate furniture.

options.label: High-density Web
options.thesis: Pack the screen with ruled modules.
options.case: Bright white and crowded; VEIL is dark-first and calm.
options.kept: Hairline-ruled density instead of empty padded cards.

options.label: Midnight Transit Diagram
options.case: Pretty, but a messenger is not a network map; clarity loses.
options.kept: Disciplined state colours that only ever mean one thing.

options.label: Orienteering Map
options.thesis: A fixed terrain with one reserved course colour.
options.case: Light, outdoorsy; nobody here identifies with it.
options.kept: One colour reserved for exactly one job.

options.label: Cassette J-card
options.kept: Tight right-aligned metadata instead of loose labels.

options.label: Exposure Record
options.thesis: Stacked translucent sheets over a zone ramp.
options.case: Elegant system, but overlapping sheets fight a chat layout.
options.kept: Neutrals from one strict tonal ramp.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: What a polished messenger ships, executed cleanly.
canonCard.viewport: Familiar list and conversation, nothing to learn.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from other messengers by design.
